title: Access Denied
description: Papers, Please on the IT service desk: verify every caller against the directory, approve or deny, and don't let the social engineer who calls every day get in.
thumbnailAlt: A Windows 95-style service desk: a caller's transcript, their ticket stamped DENIED, and the directory record showing the real spelling of their name

title: Helpdesk Survivors: Doom Mode
description: The helpdesk as a 1993-style shooter: fight through two floors of users with your IT tools, find the access badges and clock out at the exit.
thumbnailAlt: A retro first-person view down an office aisle, ticket gun in hand, with a security guard, a confused user and two managers walking up

title: Helpdesk Survivors 3D
description: The helpdesk shift rebuilt in 3D: five office floors, nineteen techs, bosses and an online leaderboard, on a phone or a computer.
thumbnailAlt: A low-poly technician in a blue polo on a 3D office floor, ringed by a crowd of office workers, with tools flying around

title: Helpdesk Survivors
description: Survive a 20-minute shift on the IT helpdesk while your tools fire on their own and the tickets swarm in.
thumbnailAlt: A pixel-art technician surrounded by office workers waving tickets on an open-plan office floor
